name: COVID-19
description: A contagious disease caused by the coronavirus SARS-CoV-2. It primarily affects the respiratory system and accesses host cells via the ACE2 receptor.
transmission: Airborne transmission via droplets/aerosols, and contact transmission.

name: Seasonal Influenza
description: An acute respiratory infection caused by influenza viruses. Severity and timing vary by location, influenced by circulating viruses and population immunity.
transmission: Airborne droplets and contact with contaminated surfaces.

name: Dengue Fever
description: A mosquito-borne viral infection causing a severe flu-like illness. Can progress to severe dengue (Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever) causing bleeding and blood plasma leakage.

name: Malaria
description: A life-threatening disease caused by Plasmodium parasites (e.g., P. falciparum, P. vivax) transmitted to people through the bites of infected female Anopheles mosquitoes.
